manifest.description: Shared markdown todo lists. Humans and agent sessions create ledgers, claim items, and complete them — one source of truth across all sessions.
manifest.author: qihang-dai

manifest.description: Edits a todo.txt file: one task per line, no database. Point it at a folder you already sync, or use the one it creates. Priorities, projects, contexts and due dates colour as you type, and the format's semantics actually run rather than just highlight: rec: rollover on completion, t: thresholds, h:1 hidden tasks. Palette verbs match the todo.txt CLI. Archiving moves completed tasks to done.txt. AI rewrites the lines you select, and stages any deletion as a diff you approve.
manifest.author: LeTeutz
